item.text: Run a low-cost, two-week demand test rather than redesigning the menu. Make a few extra units of the item that sells out early, while reducing production of the slowest leftovers. Track sell-through time, customer requests after sellout, and waste by item each day. Ask customers a one-question survey at checkout or on social media about preferred products and times. Compare results across weekdays and weekends, then adjust quantities gradually based on evidence.
